text:
jamie: Man City vs Real tonight — anyone up for streaming in Conf C? Kickoff 11:30pm PT, I can swing by early to set up.
sophia: I'm in! Pizza? No peanuts pls :pizza: :no_entry_sign::peanuts: 
arun: Conf C is HDMI-only, bring a dongle. Projector remote is in the AV closet.
taylor: I can bring a USB-C -> HDMI + speaker. If it's >8 ppl can we RSVP so we know pizza count? I'll make a calendar event.
devops-bot: calendar: Created event "Match Night — Conf C" at 11:15pm PT. Invites sent to @jamie @sophia @arun @taylor @maria.
maria: Thanks — heads up someone in the office has a peanut allergy, please keep it peanut-free. @people-ops
jamie: Got it. I'll order 2 large margherita + 1 vegan. Any other dietary needs?
arun: FYI the official stream is geo-blocked here — anyone have a workaround? VPN or alternative link?
sophia: I have a TNT login via a friend (DM me). If that fails, Fubo has a 7-day trial that works.
taylor: Backup plan if stream dies: radio commentary + projector scoreboard? :laughing:
maria: Quick poll — who’s wearing their team kit? React with :one: City, :two: Real, :three: neutral.
jamie: Also desperate — someone bring a spare HDMI->USB-C adapter please.
arun: I can bring one. Also small fantasy stake idea: loser buys beers for the next demo day? 🙃
sophia: :100: game on.
_notes: Slack-style short thread for an office match-night watch: logistics, allergy flag, streaming fallback, small fantasy bet. Contains a bot calendar line and emoji shortcodes.
